zoning_facts.data_center_use: Special exception (conditional use) since 2025-03-18; no longer by right. Special exception use in IP, GI and MR-HI districts per the Phase 1 amendments (CPAM-2024-0001 / ZOAM-2024-0001).
zoning_facts.where_allowed: Only on land zoned for office or industrial uses; rural policy area districts (about two-thirds of the county) do not allow data centers.
zoning_facts.moratorium_authority: County states it lacks legal authority for a moratorium; Virginia law requires each rezoning or special exception be considered within a set period.
zoning_facts.transmission: County has no formal role approving high-voltage transmission routes; the SCC approves them. County supports undergrounding within 500 ft of residences or schools but cannot require it.

rules.authority: Loudoun County Board of Supervisors (Planning Commission recommends)
rules.trigger_note: Rezoning (ZMAP) when the parcel's district does not allow data centers, plus special exception(s) (SPEX) for the use and any FAR or lot-coverage increases; Loudoun bundles these under one LEGI number.

steps.name: Acceptance to Planning Commission public hearing (staff review, referrals, resubmissions)

duration.note: Cross Mill about 18-19 months and Spring Valley about 24 months, with filing months estimated from application-number years. IN-SAMPLE: these cases also form the backtest.

steps.name: Planning Commission hearing to Board decision

duration.note: Cross Mill 9.7 months (PC hearing 2024-09-24, approval 2025-07-15). Statutory cap 12 months unless the applicant consents; Loudoun runs the clock from referral to the PC hearing.

rules.trigger_note: Only for applications under review as of 2025-02-12 that are more than 500 ft from residential areas and not substantially changed.

duration.note: No separate land-use step; the site plan is the review

rules.trigger_note: Utility transmission substation by special exception; filed inside the data center LEGI when there is one (Arcola Grove LEGI-2023-0071, Spring Valley's three substations).

steps.name: Acceptance to Planning Commission public hearing
Planning Commission hearing to Board decision

duration.note: Statute: 60 days then deemed approved unless extended; run concurrently with the legislative case (assumed)
Statute gives 40 days per first review and 30 per resubmission; multiple rounds assumed. Calibrate from LandMARC records.

LC_PAUSE_2026.summary: Board deferral of final votes on legislative data center and substation applications. Applications can still be filed and heard by the Planning Commission; none become inactive. Administrative (by-right) cases unaffected.
LC_PAUSE_2026.status: Proposed. Board directed staff on 2026-09-15 (7-1-1) to draft a resolution, described as retroactive to that date; the county's Sept 16 statement called the pause enacted, but its Oct 20 release calls it a proposal and defers the resolution (item 14p) to the 2026-11-17 business meeting.

release_target.note: Phase 2 Board hearing and business meeting scheduled July 2027; P90 assumes a one-quarter slip

exceptions: Applications whose statutory decision period is about to expire

LC_GRANDFATHER_2025.summary: By-right treatment for applications under review on 2025-02-12 and more than 500 ft from residential areas. About 17-20 such cases remain. A proposal to rescind it went to the County Attorney; legal opinion due 2026-10-06; no rescission adopted as of the last check.

LC_PHASE2.summary: Phase 2 amendments in drafting: use-specific standards for data centers and utility substations, building height, on-site power generation and energy storage, noise, parking, and deletion of the Urban Employment district. Planning Commission hearing Feb 2027; Board hearing and vote July 2027.

Rural.note: Rural policy area districts do not allow data centers

Transition.note: Comprehensive plan intends open space, residential and recreational uses; staff and Planning Commission (6-0) recommended denial of Spring Valley Technology Park on 2026-07-23 citing Transition Policy Area inconsistency

JLMA.note: Joint Land Management Area near Leesburg; Cross Mill rezoned JLMA-20 to PD-IP after a 5-4 vote

Suburban.note: Default for office/industrial place types; still legislative since 2025-03-18

Urban.note: Phase 2 proposes deleting the Urban Employment district
